newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RUGBY LEAGUE-FITTLER HURT AS ST GEORGE DOWN CITY.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY LEAGUE-FITTLER HURT AS ST GEORGE DOWN CITY.

text.p: St George took advantage of a leg
injury suffered by Australia captain Brad Fittler and scored six
tries to defeat Sydney City 36-16 in an Australian Rugby League
(ARL) premiership playoff match on Sunday.
Fittler suffered a recurrence of a groin injury and limped
from the field 16 minutes into the match when Sydney City led
4-0 after a try by winger Darren Junee.
Sydney City lacked inspiration after the departure of their
chief playmaker, allowing St George to score three unanswered
tries for a 16-4 halftime lead.
A brave Fittler returned to the field after the break but
was visibly hampered by the injury and hobbled off again seven
minutes into the second half after St George scored their fourth
try for a 22-4 lead.
The St George forwards dominated their Sydney City
opponents, allowing their backline to create scoring
opportunities almost at will.
Centre Mark Bell and winger Adrian Brunker scored two tries
each as St George crossed the City line six times, five of their
tries coming from clever short kicks.
St George will now play North Sydney in a semifinal next
Saturday for the right to progress to the ARL grand final on
September 29.
Manly, who topped the ARL regular season standings, will
take on Cronulla next Sunday in the other semifinal after
Cronulla upset Brisbane 22-16 on Saturday.
Sydney City had won their first 10 ARL matches in succession
this year before suffering a mid-year slump. City coach Phil
Gould told reporters up to 10 of his players had carried
injuries into Sunday's match
